archetypes.name: dyn-shell-harness-parity
archetypes.rationale: Parity gaps between deleted Bash harnesses and the new pytest module are the main regression risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare every PASS/assert label from the former test-step-8-ship.sh, test-step-18.sh, and test-implement-review-token-propagation.sh against named nodes in python/tests/implement/test_implement_shell_scripts.py. Flag missing dynamic cases for bgjob rejoin, merge-result fail-closed, Step 18 ordering, and unsafe timing-ledger rejection. Confirm Step 5 coverage is wrapper-shape only and does not nest pytest. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
